title.narrative: ID: Changing the Way we Care GDA (CTWWC)

description.narrative: (USAID Bureau for Inclusive Growth, Partnerships, and Innovation (IPI)): This activity addresses the issue of children living outside of family care by strengthening government systems to identify vulnerable children and place them in safe family care settings. With FY 2024 funds, the activity will continue to work with families and communities to prevent unnecessary separation and promote global efforts to shift from residential and institutional care to a family-based care model. This activity contributes to the U.S. government's Advancing Protection and Care for Children in Adversity (Thrive) strategy and helps ensure that the U.S. government's investments for the most vulnerable children are comprehensive, coordinated, and effective in helping countries sustainably finance, manage, and deliver services that lead to strong families and communities. This IM implements the Vulnerable Children directive/earmark.
